title: Litecoin LTC Price Analysis: HUGE Bullish Signal Incoming! #shorts
description: Litecoin's extremely oversold! Crypto Meow spots a potential generational bottom & dollar-cost averaging opportunity. Is a bounce to $70 possible, or will it fall to the shadow realm? Key levels to watch in this update. #Litecoin #CryptoAnalysis #Altcoins #CryptoMeow #Bitcoin

asr.full_text: Good morning everyone. It's Cryptomio Analysis coming at you with an update video on Litecoin. So this is very, very, very awesome for Litecoin because you are now in the box and you are extremely oversold on the daily, which I said this is theoretically a really good place to dollar cost average and buy Litecoin, in my opinion, which is where I'm going to start. So on the weekly, it's almost also extremely oversold. I don't think I'm going to, I don't care if it goes down a little bit more and actually breaks this. Because again, like we said, last time, this general, this marks a generational bottom for Litecoin. So you have, you have May 2022 and then you had a monster rally and then you had back here, December 8th, December of 2018. And then you had a monster rally and then you had back here december december of 2018 and then you had a monster rally so i'm pretty excited about it you don't have to agree with me um you know this could all of a sudden just be a dead coin and it could go to zero but i don't think it will so we're just gonna have to wait and see but in terms of target score you're sitting on support right now and it's bearish as long as it's under $70 so you might get some sort of bounce that takes you back up to $70 if it if it gets stuck there that's a very bearish because you're gonna get stuck back down to the shadow realm and then on the macro time frame you need to break $99 and then we can say bullish reversals and play. i will keep you updated none of this is financial advice it is just my opinion thank you so much for your support and i'll catch you in the next video
